|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 5) of the Virtual Modern Alternate Image (ALT) card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Jakku (Dark) (ALT) (Errata 4)]] (PC-E4). The image is the Players Committee printing of this version ([[:File:V4-D-jakku_ai-2021-02-18.png]]). Each version below is a published PC printing (card image or errata sheet slip); card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later), slip dates are the errata sheet's PDF date. Every visibly different printing is a separate version, and an errata sheet slip is a version of its own, separate from the card image of the same errata (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 18 February 2021<ref name="img-Dark91ca80c">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/jakku_ai.png</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/91ca80c51880e683322c125b7a0b6ec807df1ab8 commit 91ca80c] (18 February 2021); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/jakku_ai.png (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “(none printed)”. Text: “'''Light Side:''' Unless your Resistance character or [Resistance] starship here, you may not draw more than one battle destiny here.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Jakku (Dark) (ALT) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 18 February 2021<ref name="img-Darke1a6ab9">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/jakku_ai.png</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e1a6ab973f90c7e27c46017e1cc0b6183821519d commit e1a6ab9] (18 February 2021); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/jakku_ai.png (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the bottom margin “Sullust (Dark)” and “(AI)” now print (the PC's first upload of the day printed neither); the bottom margin “(none printed)” → “Sullust (Dark)”; the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Sullust (Dark)”. Text: “'''Light Side:''' Unless your Resistance character or [Resistance] starship here, you may not draw more than one battle destiny here.”
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Jakku (Dark) (ALT) (Errata 2)]]): PC card image uploaded 19 February 2021<ref name="img-Dark83cacba">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/jakku_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/83cacbafbf6096e6be059d69fda34cf93fe24c68 commit 83cacba] (19 February 2021); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/jakku_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). '''What changed:''' the PC replaced its high-resolution PNG upload of the day before with the GIF made from it for Holotable (the PNG was moved to the “hires” folder); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (703×980 → 745×1039 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Sullust (Dark)”. Text: “'''Light Side:''' Unless your Resistance character or [Resistance] starship here, you may not draw more than one battle destiny here.”

Text: “'''Light Side:''' Unless your Resistance character or [Resistance] starship here, you may not draw more than one battle destiny here.”
